info.name: AUTOMATION EXERCISE API TESTING

item.name: 05 - Security Testing

exec: pm.test("logs security-relevant headers for manual review", function () {

request.description: Checks for the presence of baseline security-related response headers. This is informational, not a strict pass/fail gate, since many demo APIs don't set every header.

exec: pm.test("server does not crash - no 5xx error", function () {

request.description: Sends a harmless script-like string as search input to confirm the API does not reflect it back unescaped (basic reflected-XSS sanity check). This is passive/read-only and not a real exploit attempt.

item.description: Beginner-friendly, non-destructive security checks: headers, sensitive data exposure, basic input validation. No brute force or DoS.
